prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished scenic background for a portrait Halloween beer-game theme. 1024 x 1536 pixels, full bleed.
Style/medium: richly painted editorial travel postcard, soft gouache with fine colored-pencil detail, believable perspective and tactile worn materials. An atmospheric nostalgic Halloween evening with friends. The setting should immediately read as Halloween at small thumbnail size, while maintaining the beautiful believable illustrative travel-book style.
Composition: eye level of someone seated at a table. A broad empty foreground tabletop fills the lower 40% of the portrait, with its rear edge around y=60% of image height. The tabletop spans the full image width. Keep the entire central 70% of the table completely EMPTY. Reserve a calm, unobstructed central area x=32–68% and especially the lower half for a separate live game glass composited later. Put distinctive Halloween decorations, lights, characters and objects to the left/right edges or above the reserved center. Small anonymous friends are distant at outer edges, never main portraits.
Constraints: scenery ONLY, no foreground drinking glass, mug, cup, bottle, can, or beer. No brand, readable text, label, signage lettering, title, interface, borders, or watermark. No graphic words or floating UI. No oversized central object. Do not draw the future game glass. No gore.
Scene/backdrop: A haunted Irish pub on Halloween night. Dark oak paneling and bar, warm orange STAINED-GLASS window at the LEFT side, a single realistic black RAVEN perched clearly on the left window ledge, its silhouette readable and slightly eerie. Several carved glowing jack-o-lanterns and old wax candles grouped on peripheral pub shelves and ledges, especially right side, never central foreground. Small friends dressed for Halloween sit at a distant right-side pub table. Copper amber and deep green-black shadows, warm old Irish pub materials, gently haunted. Foreground broad empty DARK OAK BAR top across lower40%, room for separate Guinness game glass, the entire central70% clean. No text, no Guinness imagery or brand, setting only.
